parts.name: Root
parts.description: The tabs container. It holds the selected value and gives the context to the list, the tabs, the indicator, and the panels.

props.name: keyboardActivation
props.description: With 'automatic', each arrow key moves the focus and activates that tab. With 'manual', the arrow keys move only the focus, and the `Enter` key or the `Space` key activates the tab.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The axis of the tab list. It also sets the axis of the arrow keys.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the full tabs group.

props.name: value
props.description: The value of the selected tab. By default it goes in the two directions: use `bind:value`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The selected value at the start, for when you give no `value`.

props.name: controlledValue
props.description:
Give your own code full control of the state. The component stops to write back to `value`, and
it reports only through `onChange`. Thus the parent can refuse a change: the parent does not
send the new value down. The default is off, because `bind:value` is the usual case and it
needs the write-back.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: The values of the tabs that take no focus and do not activate.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The component calls it when the selected tab changes.

props.name: children
props.description: The list part and the panel parts.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the root element. The component makes the ids of the tabs and of the panels from it. If you give none, the component makes one.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the root element.

props.name: context
props.description: A bindable object with the state of the tabs, for a complex composition. It has the selected value, the focused value, the orientation, and the activation functions.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the whole tabs group is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The configured orientation ('horizontal' | 'vertical').

dataAttributes.name: data-tabs-root
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the root element.

parts.name: List
parts.description: The strip of tabs. It has role="tablist", and it controls the roving focus between the tabs.

props.name: children
props.description: The tab parts and the indicator part.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the list element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the whole tabs group is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The configured orientation ('horizontal' | 'vertical').

dataAttributes.name: data-tabs-list
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the list element.

parts.name: Tab
parts.description: One tab button. It has role="tab" with aria-selected, and its aria-controls attribute points at its panel.

props.name: value
props.description: The unique value that joins this tab to the panel with the same value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops this tab. It takes no focus and it does not activate.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the tab.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the button element.

dataAttributes.name: data-activation-direction
dataAttributes.description: The direction of the move from the tab that was active before ('left' | 'right' | 'up' | 'down').

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the tab is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the tab has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The configured orientation ('horizontal' | 'vertical').

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present while the tab is the active tab.

dataAttributes.name: data-tabs-tab
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the tab element.

dataAttributes.name: data-tabs-value
dataAttributes.description: The tab's value, stringified.

dataAttributes.name: data-tabs-value-type
dataAttributes.description: The runtime type of the tab's value ('string' | 'number').

parts.name: Indicator
parts.description: An optional mark on the active tab. It measures the active tab and gives its position and its size in the --active-tab-left, --active-tab-top, --active-tab-width, and --active-tab-height CSS variables.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the indicator.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the span element.

dataAttributes.name: data-activation-direction
dataAttributes.description: The direction of the move from the tab that was active before ('left' | 'right' | 'up' | 'down').

dataAttributes.name: data-hidden
dataAttributes.description: Present when no tab is active.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The configured orientation ('horizontal' | 'vertical').

dataAttributes.name: data-tabs-indicator
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the indicator element.

parts.name: Panel
parts.description: The content of one tab. It has role="tabpanel" with aria-labelledby. While its tab is not active, it is hidden.

props.name: value
props.description: The value of the tab of this panel.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keeps the panel in the DOM, and hidden, while its tab is not active. Thus the panel keeps its DOM state.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the panel.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the panel element.

dataAttributes.name: data-hidden
dataAttributes.description: Present while the tab of the panel is not active and the panel is hidden.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present while the tab of the panel is active.

dataAttributes.name: data-tabs-panel
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the panel element.

dataAttributes.name: data-tabs-value
dataAttributes.description: The panel's value, stringified.

dataAttributes.name: data-tabs-value-type
dataAttributes.description: The runtime type of the panel's value ('string' | 'number').
